steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the eRFX capability required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title for publishing.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Verify the product's mapped variant was filled automatically.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Confirm the delivery location was selected.

args.goal: on the buyer's single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", verify both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", and click Done; stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the two specified mandatory terms, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA test vendor for the vendor-side submission.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Verify the first mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept the first mandatory clause.
Accept the second mandatory clause.
Quote 100 for the line and submit after accepting both terms.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer sees confirmation that the bidding vendor accepted the terms.
